preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some BossBaby tokens to trigger the swap mechanism
Contract must have accumulated marketing fees (balanceOf(address(this)) >= swapTokensAtAmount)

exploit_hint: Set up a malicious contract as the marketingWallet that reverts on receiving BNB via sendValue(). Then trigger a sell transaction to the uniswapV2Pair when contract has accumulated marketing fees. This will cause swapAndSendMarketing to revert, preventing fee processing and allowing you to sell tokens without paying marketing fees while other users' transactions fail. The attacker benefits by avoiding fee payments and potentially causing denial-of-service for legitimate transfers.
